==25%==
Amir plays three notes on his clarinet. If Jacob clashes his cymbals twice every time Jo plays a flute note and Jo plays five times as many notes as Amir, how many times does Jacob clash?

Amir plays three notes. Jo plays five times as many as Amir – i.e. 15 notes. Jacob clashes his cymbals twice every time Jo plays a note, so it is 15 x 2 = '''30'''.
